CASE-UNDER-STICKY-HEADER sits under the fixed header at the top of the page.

CASE-COVERED-SOLID is under a box painted the page's colour.

CASE-COVERED-BEHIND-PARENT is pushed behind its parent's background.

CASE-PARTLY-COVERED has only its first words under a box.

CASE-UNDER-TRANSLUCENT is under a half-transparent white.

CASE-UNDER-FADED is under a solid box at half opacity.

CASE-UNDER-BLENDED is under a white box that multiplies with what is below it.

CASE-POINTER-EVENTS-COVER is under a box the pointer passes through.

CASE-UNDER-PICTURE is under a picture.

CASE-TEXT-ABOVE-BOX is drawn above a box.

CASE-UNDER-DIALOG-ELEMENT is under an open dialog.

CASE-UNDER-MODAL sits under the dialog box of a modal.

CASE-COVERED-BELOW-FOLD is under a box far down the page.

CASE-VISIBLE-BELOW-FOLD shows far down the page.

CASE-UNDER-COOKIE-BANNER sits under the fixed banner at the bottom of the page.
